Following Hägele et al. [1] (2024) which recommends WSD schedulers with half the maximum learning rates as a cosine schedule, we adopt learning rates 2.5× higher than GPT-3 (Radford et al. [1] 2019) standards; this corresponds to half of the maximum learning rate used in Gu and Dao (2024), yielding 6.25 × 10−4 for Large-scale models and 5.0 × 10−4 for XL-scale models.
